phase3c_scope.beyond_prompt_summary: The counterpart search failed at every wavelength. Swift-XRT found two uncatalogued sources in the 236 sq arcmin IPN box (GCN 13790) and then showed NEITHER fades over 134-573 ks (GCN 13821, verbatim: 'implying we have not detected any X-ray counterpart to this GRB'; 3 sigma limit ~1.0e-13 erg cm-2 s-1). Swift-UVOT: m2 > 21.4 at 134 ks, with a catalogued USNO-B1 source (m2 = 20.52 +/- 0.17) within 4.5 arcsec of XRT source 1 - a coincidence to exclude, not a host. GROND: non-detection at 2.67 d. Galactic reddening E(B-V) = 0.10. IMPLICATION FOR IDENTITY: follow-up began only 1.55 d after the trigger because the IPN box took 8 h to publish and is far larger than XRT can tile promptly, so the non-detections are consistent with an ordinary afterglow that simply decayed - they carry NO information about the prompt outflow, and NOTHING in the afterglow record biases the prompt spectrum in either direction. No redshift anywhere => all distance-dependent analysis (including the #43 photospheric-diagnostics Tier B) is CLOSED for this burst.
